All 17 rules reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations (2), both redlined:**
- **LOL-CAP** — The §21.1 cap is mutual with excellent carve-outs, but its basis is illusory: "Fees" is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so both parties' aggregate liability is effectively capped at USD 12,000. Redlined to the greater of all amounts paid or payable in the preceding 12 months and USD 1,000,000.
- **LD** — §7.7 imposes uncapped liquidated damages on Customer of 15% of annual Fees per week of late payment. Deleted; interest on undisputed overdue amounts offered instead.

**Compliant (15):** INDEMN, NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN (runs in our favour), NOSOLICIT, T4C, RENEWAL, GOVLAW, ASSIGN, IP, LICENSE, AUDIT, WARRANTY, INSURANCE, MINCOMMIT, TRANSITION — nearly all at the preferred position, with §12.3 affirmatively disclaiming any restrictive covenants on us.
